name: Vaseline Gluta-Hya Dewy Radiance 200ml Serum-In-Lotion, Boosted With GlutaGlow | India
description:
Product details of Vaseline Gluta-Hya Dewy Radiance Serum-In-Lotion – 200ml (India)

Product Type: Serum-In-Lotion / Body Lotion

Size: 200ml

Origin: India

Key Features:

GlutaGlow Technology: 10× more powerful than Vitamin C, helps reduce dullness and boosts skin radiance

Hyaluron: Deeply hydrates and locks in moisture for dewy, supple skin

10× Active Niacinamide: Enhances skin’s natural radiance and brightness

Vaseline Jelly: Locks moisture deep within for long-lasting hydration

First-ever concentrated serum lotion by Vaseline – combines lotion and serum for intensive care

Helps achieve bright, dewy, and glowing skin
